data.title: IM Cannabis Corp. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC and GLIL YAM, Israel, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- IM Cannabis Corp. (the "Company") () announced its financial results for the third quarter and first nine months ended September 30, 2026.

For the third quarter of 2026, revenue totaled C$1.65 million, compared to C$5.08 million in the same period last year. The Company reported a gross loss of C$35,000 and a total net loss of C$7.08 million, compared to a net loss of C$3.87 million in the third quarter of 2025. For the first nine months of 2026, revenue totaled C$8.96 million, compared to C$15.77 million in the corresponding period of 2025, while total net loss amounted to C$13.93 million, compared to C$3.88 million.

In September 2026, the Company announced a non-binding agreement to acquire a 51% stake in Space Defense Innovations LLC (SDI), a Polish company operating in the unmanned aerial systems sector through its subsidiary BlueAero Group, which distributes tactical UAS products manufactured by BlueBird Aero Systems. The Company is currently negotiating a definitive share purchase agreement with SDI's shareholders.

Separately, the Company completed the sale of its European-focused operations, including its German subsidiary Adjupharm GmbH, to Slil.com Holding Ltd. on September 29, 2026, following a restructuring under which the Company's Israeli medical cannabis operations were retained. The transaction consideration included a C$3 million advance payment and the assumption of certain liabilities of up to C$9.4 million. The Company expects the transaction to improve shareholders' equity by approximately C$3 million.

The full Interim Financial Statements and Management's Discussion and Analysis are available on SEDAR+ and EDGAR.

About IM Cannabis Corp.

IM Cannabis Corp. () is an international company operating a medical cannabis platform serving patients in Israel.

The Company's ecosystem operates in Israel through its subsidiaries, which import and distribute cannabis to medical patients, leveraging years of proprietary data and patient insights. The Company also operates medical cannabis retail pharmacies and online platforms in Israel that enable the safe delivery and quality control of IMCC's products throughout the value chain.

data.title: Accuray Closes TCW Transaction, Strengthening Balance Sheet to Support Long-Term Value Growth
data.description:
MADISON, Wis., Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Accuray Incorporated () today announced that it has completed its financing transaction with TCW Asset Management Company LLC ("TCW"), the company's primary lender and largest shareholder. The transaction significantly reduces Accuray's debt, adds new capital and waives certain financial covenants through December 31, 2027. Together, these steps put the company's balance sheet on a firmer footing as it carries out the next phase of its previously announced strategic transformation.

The closing follows stockholder approval of all transaction-related proposals at Accuray's Special Meeting of Stockholders on October 6, 2026, and the 1-for-40 reverse stock split of the company's common stock, which took effect on November 9, 2026.

With the closing, the following terms are now in effect among other components:

  • Deleveraging: TCW has exchanged $40 million in aggregate principal amount of its term loan for convertible preferred stock.
  • Equity investment: TCW invested $15 million in cash when the transaction agreements were signed in July. That investment has now been exchanged for additional shares of the convertible preferred stock.
  • Covenant holiday: Certain financial covenants under the company's existing term loan are waived through December 31, 2027. The first covenant test date is March 31, 2028.
  • Additional liquidity: A delayed draw term loan of up to $5 million in aggregate principal amount is available to Accuray, subject to certain conditions.
  • Governance: The size of the company's board of directors was reduced from 8 to 7, with TCW having the right to appoint two directors of the 7 board members. Steven Mayer and Chan Galbato, current members of the board, serve as designees for TCW. As previously announced, Richard A. ("Randy") Meier joined Accuray's Board of Directors as an independent director in October 2026.
  • Reverse Stock Split: a 1-for-40 reverse stock split of the company's common stock took effect on November 9, 2026.

"Completing this transaction is an important milestone for Accuray as it strengthens our balance sheet. As we move forward, we continue to stay focused on our mission and on delivering innovative technology and service to our customers and their patients. I want to thank TCW for believing in our plan and our stockholders for standing behind us," said Steve La Neve, Accuray's CEO.

The completed transaction is a key part of Accuray's Transformation Phase II, the plan Accuray outlined in July 2026 to strengthen its competitive position and drive long-term growth. Phase II strategy is anchored in three priorities: advancing differentiated innovation, continuing to lower the company's cost structure, and expanding market reach through direct and partner channels.

Additional information about the completion of the transaction will be included in a Current Report on Form 8-K to be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

About Accuray

Accuray is committed to expanding the powerful potential of radiation therapy to improve as many lives as possible. We invent unique, market-changing solutions designed to deliver radiation treatments for even the most complex cases—while making commonly treatable cases even easier—to meet the full spectrum of patient needs. We are dedicated to continuous innovation in radiation therapy for oncology, neuro-radiosurgery, and beyond, as we partner with clinicians and administrators, empowering them to help patients get back to their lives, faster. Accuray is headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin, with facilities worldwide. To learn more, visit www.accuray.com or follow us on Facebook, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

About TCW

TCW is a global asset management firm with more than fifty years of experience in fixed income, equities, and alternative strategies. Guided by a disciplined, research-driven approach, TCW concentrates on areas where deep expertise makes a meaningful difference. Through rigorous fundamental analysis, prudent risk management, and high-conviction decision-making, TCW strives to construct portfolios that uncover opportunities and deliver enduring value. TCW partners with institutions, insurers, financial advisors, and individual investors worldwide, providing clarity and a long-term perspective to help clients navigate ever-changing markets. For more information, please visit www.tcw.com.

data.title: Pacific Imperial Announces Non-Brokered Private Placement
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

Vancouver, British Columbia – November 13, 2026 - TheNewswire – Pacific Imperial Mines Inc. (TSX.V: PPM) (“Pacific Imperial” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it intends to complete a non-brokered private placement (the “Private Placement”) of flow-through units and non-flow through units, as described below.

Private Placement

The Private Placement will consist of the sale of: (i) up to 33,333,333 flow-through units of the Company (each, a “FT Unit”) at a price of $0.075 per FT Unit for gross proceeds of up to $2,500,000, and (ii) up to 20,000,000 non-flow-through units of the Company (each, a “NFT Unit”) at a price of $0.075 per NFT Unit for gross proceeds of up to $1,500,000.

Each FT Unit will be comprised of one common share of the Company to be issued on a flow-through basis under the Income Tax Act (Canada) (a “FT Share”) and one non-flow-through common share purchase warrant (a “Warrant”). Each Warrant will be exercisable by the holder thereof to acquire one non-flow-through common share of the Company (a “NFT Share”) at an exercise price of $0.10 per NFT Share for a period of five years from the date of issuance of the Warrant. The Warrants will be transferable.

Each NFT Unit will be comprised of one NFT Share and one Warrant with identical terms to the Warrants underlying the FT Units.

No finder fees will be paid for the financing.

The Company intends to use the gross proceeds of the Private Placement towards mining exploration expenditures and for general working capital purposes. The Company will use the gross proceeds from the issuance of FT Shares to incur “Canadian exploration expenses” and qualify as “flow-through mining expenditures”, as such terms are defined in the Income Tax Act (Canada).

The securities issued pursuant to the Private Placement will be subject to a four-month hold period commencing from the applicable closing date of the Private Placement in accordance with applicable securities laws. The Private Placement is subject to certain closing conditions, including the approval of the Exchange.

This press release shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy nor shall there be any sale of the securities in the United States or in any other jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful. The securities have not been registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from the registration requirements thereunder.

About Pacific Imperial Mines

Pacific Imperial is a mineral exploration company based in Vancouver, Canada, engaged in the acquisition, exploration, evaluation and development of mineral properties in an acceptable risk environment. The Company’s current focus is on the Babine and Fenton properties in B.C.

data.title: Dark Star Appoints Mr. Rod Campbell as President, Chief Executive Officer and Director, Announces Financing and Adoption of Semi-Annual Reporting
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA, NOVEMBER 13, 2026 – TheNewswire - DARK STAR MINERALS INC. (CSE: BATT; WKN: A429LR | FSE: P0W0) (the “Company” or “Dark Star”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. Rod Campbell as President, Chief Executive Officer (“CEO”) and a director of the Company, effective immediately. Mr. Campbell succeeds Mr. Marc Branson, who will continue to serve as a director of the Company. Dark Star would like to thank Mr. Branson for his tenure as CEO and his continued involvement as a director.

Mr. Campbell is a seasoned professional with extensive expertise in financial services and the energy sector. He previously served as a Financial Advisor at BMO Nesbitt Burns, where he developed strong client relationships and an in-depth knowledge of the finance industry. Complementing this, Mr. Campbell brings 17 years of hands-on experience in the oil and gas sector, during which he oversaw procurement and fuel business development for leading companies, including Encana, Apache Corporation, Canadian Hunter Exploration, Elbow River Resources, ERS, and MP Energy.

Concurrent with Mr. Campbell’s appointment, Mr. Doug Unwin has resigned from the Company’s board of directors. Mr. Unwin will continue to serve the Company as an advisor.

Mr. Campbell, CEO & Director states: “I am excited to lead Dark Star at what I believe is a compelling time for uranium exploration. Nuclear power has a critical role to play in meeting the world’s growing energy needs, and I see significant long-term opportunity in the uranium sector. Our focus will be on advancing the Company’s project portfolio, pursuing opportunities for growth and building lasting shareholder value. I look forward to working with the team to realize Dark Star’s potential. On behalf of the Board, I would also like to thank Mr. Unwin for his significant efforts and valuable contributions, and I am pleased that we will continue to benefit from his experience as an advisor.”

Additionally, the Company is pleased to announce that it is conducting a non-brokered private placement (the “Offering”) of up to 15,000,000 units (the “Units”) at a price of $0.05 per Unit, including the settlement of $506,358.42 CAD of outstanding debt through the issuance of Units to certain creditors of the Company. This debt includes $304,120.00 CAD of interest free loans that were loaned to the Company for the purposes of advancing it’s Uranium project portfolio.

Each Unit will consist of one common share in the capital of the Company (each, a “Share”) and one Share purchase warrant (each, a “Warrant”). Each Warrant will be exercisable to purchase one additional Share (each, a “Warrant Share”) at an exercise price of $0.10 per Warrant Share for a period of 36 months after the date of issuance, subject to acceleration, Shareholder Approval (as defined below) and a restriction on exercise, each as described below.

The Warrants will be subject to an acceleration provision such that if, at any time following the later of (i) the date that is four months and one day after the date of issuance of the issuance of the Warrant, and (ii) the date on which Shareholder Approval is obtained, the volume-weighted average trading price of the Shares on the Canadian Securities Exchange (the “CSE”), or any other market on which the Shares are then listed, equals or exceeds $0.20 per Share for five consecutive trading days, the Company may accelerate the expiry date of the Warrants by providing written notice to Warrant holders or issuing a news release. In such circumstances, any Warrants that remain unexercised will expire at 5:00 p.m. (Vancouver time) on the date that is 30 days following the date of such notice or news release.

The Warrants will include a provision restricting exercise if such exercise would result in the holder, together with any persons acting jointly or in concert with the holder, owning 10% or more of the issued and outstanding Shares immediately following such exercise.

The Offering could result in the issuance of up to 30,000,000 Shares, assuming the exercise of all Warrants, which represents more than 100% of the Company’s 17,036,814 currently issued and outstanding Shares. Accordingly, pursuant to the policies of the CSE, the exercise of the Warrants is subject to the approval of the Company’s shareholders at its next meeting (the “Meeting”) of shareholders (“Shareholder Approval”). The Warrants will not be exercisable unless and until Shareholder Approval is obtained. If Shareholder Approval is not obtained, all Warrants issued under the Offering will be cancelled immediately following the Meeting, without payment or compensation to the holders. Cancellation of the Warrants will not affect the Shares forming part of the Units or the settlement of any indebtedness through the issuance of Units.

The Company intends to use the proceeds from the Offering for mineral exploration programs and for general working capital purposes. All securities issued in connection with the Offering will be subject to a statutory hold period of four months plus a day from the date of issuance in accordance with applicable securities laws. The Company may pay finder's fees on the Offering within the amount permitted under the policies of the CSE and applicable securities laws.

This news release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any of the securities in the United States. The securities have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “U.S. Securities Act”) or any state securities laws and may not be offered or sold within the United States or to U.S. persons unless registered under the U.S. Securities Act and applicable state securities laws or an exemption from such registration is available.

The Company also announces that it has elected to rely on Coordinated Blanket Order 51-933 Exemptions to Permit Semi-Annual Reporting for Certain Venture Issuers (the “Blanket Order”) and move to semi-annual financial reporting. This news release is being filed pursuant to Coordinated Blanket Order 51-933 Exemptions to Permit Semi-Annual Reporting for Certain Venture Issuers. The Blanket Order permits eligible venture issuers to voluntarily move from quarterly to semi-annual financial reporting.

The Company has determined that it meets the eligibility criteria under the Blanket Order. These include that the Company:

  • is a venture issuer with securities listed on the CSE;

  • has been a reporting issuer in a jurisdiction of Canada for at least 12 months;

  • had revenue of no more than $10 million, as shown in its most recently filed audited annual financial statements;

  • has filed all required periodic and timely disclosure documents; and

  • has not, in the preceding 12 months, been subject to a penalty, sanction or cease trade order of the kind described in the Blanket Order.

The Company’s financial year ends on December 31. Under the Blanket Order, the Company will be exempt from filing interim financial reports and related management’s discussion and analysis (“MD&A”) for its first and third quarters. The initial interim period for which the Company will not file an interim financial report and related MD&A in reliance on the Blanket Order will be the three and nine-month period ended September 30, 2026. The Company will also not file an interim financial report and related MD&A for the three-month period ending March 31, 2027, or for the corresponding interim periods in subsequent years while it continues to rely on the Blanket Order. The Company will continue to file its audited annual financial statements and related MD&A within 120 days of its financial year end, and its six-month interim financial report and related MD&A within 60 days of June 30.

By adopting semi-annual financial reporting, the Company aims to reduce the administrative and financial burden associated with quarterly reporting. The Company remains committed to timely disclosure and will continue to report all material changes and significant developments as required under National Instrument 51-102 Continuous Disclosure Obligations and the policies of the CSE.

About Dark Star Minerals Inc.

Dark Star Minerals Inc. is a mineral exploration company focused on the strategic acquisition and advancement of uranium and critical mineral resources. The Company holds an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Lamont Lake Project in the Athabasca Basin of Saskatchewan, a 100% interest in the Ghost Lake claims located in the prolific CMB of Newfoundland and Labrador, comprising 28,575 ha of contiguous claim blocks, and owns the Bleasdell Project spanning over 515 ha in Northern Saskatchewan, Canada.

Investors and stakeholders are encouraged to follow the Company via its social media profiles on X and LinkedIn as well as subscribe for updates at www.darkstarminerals.com

data.description:
Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 13, 2026) - Battery Mineral Resources Corp. (OTCQB: BTRMF) ("Battery" or "BMR" or the "Company") announces that Jennifer Fulton Anderson has resigned as Chief Financial Officer for personal reasons, and that the Company's Board of Directors has appointed Sergios Abad, currently Chief Financial Officer of the Company's Punitaqui Mining Complex, as Interim Chief Financial Officer, effective November 13, 2026. The Company has begun a search for a permanent Chief Financial Officer.

Laz Nikeas, Chief Executive Officer of BMR, stated: "On behalf of the Board and management, we wish to thank Jennifer for her hard work and dedicated service to the Company over the past year. Jennifer was instrumental in delivering results against key milestones across the organization, and we are grateful for her contributions. We wish Jennifer all the best. We are also pleased to have Sergios step into the interim role. His knowledge of our Punitaqui operations and finance team provides continuity while we complete the search for a permanent successor."

About Battery Mineral Resources Corp.

Battery Mineral Resources operates the Punitaqui Mining Complex, a historic copper, gold, and silver-producing mine in the Coquimbo region of Chile. The Company's portfolio also includes 100%-owned ESI Energy Services Inc. and North American mineral exploration assets. The Company is focused on providing shareholders with accretive exposure to copper and the global trend of electrification while targeting growth through cash flow, exploration and acquisitions in favorable mining jurisdictions. data.title: U.S. Stocks Mixed on Nvidia Fallout Fears — Update
data.description:
By Rob Curran and Vicky Ge Huang

U.S. stocks were mixed as rate fears resurfaced and tumult at Nvidia spilled into the wider semiconductor sector, dragging down technology indexes.

The selling extended to chip makers such as Advanced Micro Devices that had appeared to benefit from rival Nvidia's deepening scandal, as investors weighed the implications of Jensen Huang's chaotic exit for the artificial-intelligence boom.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 50.46 points, or 0.10%, to 52347.55. Meanwhile, the broad S&P 500 slipped 30.73 points, or 0.40%, to 7561.67 and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite declined 229.82 points, or 0.91%, to 25136.27.

Shares of Nvidia tumbled 13% this week, their steepest weekly drop since April 2025, when President Trump's sweeping tariff announcements rattled global investors. The rout wiped off $573 billion from the company, its largest weekly market-cap loss on record.

The selloff also extended to other chipmakers on Friday. The PHLX Semiconductor index, which includes Nvidia rivals like AMD and Broadcom, fell 3.4% on the day, though it still logged a weekly gain of 8%. Shares of AMD slid 8.8% Friday, erasing $84 billion off its market value.

Producer prices rose 6.5% in October from a year earlier, hitting a roughly four-year high. Still, the wholesale inflation rate was slightly more muted than economists had predicted.

The principal source of recent inflationary pressures, the Strait of Hormuz, remains an expensive and treacherous chokepoint for global oil shipping.

Oil futures ticked down 18 cents, or 0.2%, to $88.56 a barrel in New York, completing their largest two-week retreat since June. Oil recouped some of its postelection losses midweek as hopes faded for a rapid resolution to the Iran war.

The yield on the policy-sensitive two-year Treasury added 0.009 percentage point to 4.872%. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note rose 0.051 percentage point to 5.152%. The 30-year bond yield rose 0.220 percentage point to 5.480%, completing its largest three-session gain since April 10, 2025.

The U.S. Dollar Index, a gauge tracking the greenback against major peers, continued its march higher due to inflation and expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December.

Rate-sensitive gold futures ticked up $1.30, or 0.03%, to $3879.70 a troy ounce, but lost 4.6% for the week, the largest drop since June.

Nvidia shares were off 2% to $162.85, a day after the ouster of former Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang. The Wall Street Journal reported that During the latter part of his tenure Huang clashed with now interim CEO Colette Kress about unconventional customer financing plans. Huang reportedly cited an "avalanche" of incoming component orders as a reason to continue providing financial backstops to potential customers.

The turmoil at Nvidia this week is "a huge setback for the AI trade," Crescat Capital's chief executive and chief investment officer Kevin Smith said. He argues that AI spending has outrun returns and that infrastructure is being built faster than it can be used. Growing competition may also squeeze chip prices, he noted, while heavy investments are pressing on hyperscalers' free cash flows.

"AI is not going away but it's a bubble that's going to unwind," Smith said. His firm is betting against the S&P 500 in anticipation of an AI-induced correction.

Cerebras Systems, a major Nvidia rival, insisted that the course of the AI boom would not be significantly altered by Huang's downfall. Shares of the company gained 11% to $108.72 after the AI chip maker's third-quarter earnings topped Wall Street expectations. The AI market is growing at an "extraordinary" pace, Cerebras Chief Executive Andrew Feldman said in an interview with The Wall Street Journal.

"I don't think the AI apocalypse is here. I think they continue to perform well, and valuations have come down," Coastal Bridge Advisors' chief investment strategist David Waddell said.

Weakness in Nvidia shares predated Huang's departure, Waddell said, arguing that rising competition was already pressuring the business. During the past week he advised clients not to buy the dip in Nvidia, and is instead recommending they make a diversified bet across chipmakers.

CoreWeave shares slid 6.1% to $53.13. The cloud-computing firm was among those that had backstop deals with Nvidia, the exclusive supplier of the chips used in its data centers. Shares of CoreWeave rival Nebius fell 10% to $115.88.

Anthropic Chief Executive Dario Amodei told JPMorgan Chase Chief Executive Jamie Dimon at the bank's Manhattan headquarters that he hoped the maker of the Claude chatbot would "underpromise and overdeliver" with its initial public offering next week.

"I think after Anthropic goes public, we'll see the real face of the market," said Lorenzo Di Mattia, founder and chief investment officer of hedge fund Sibilla Global Fund. Di Mattia placed a bet against U.S. stocks early this week.

Outside the tech sector, American depositary receipts of Richemont declined 3.5% to $20.26 after the Swiss owner of luxury watch brand Cartier posted a slowdown in quarterly sales growth. Luxury firms, which had thrived for much of the last decade, have fallen significantly this year fashion trends shift.

Write to Rob Curran at rob.curran@wsj.com and Vicky Ge Huang at vicky.huang@wsj.com

data.title: Intermarket Backs Pyxus Debt Restructuring with 3.8% Stake
data.description:
Intermarket Backs Pyxus Debt Restructuring with 3.8% Stake

Intermarket Corporation, an investment adviser, disclosed beneficial ownership of 946,509 shares, equal to 3.8% of Pyxus International, Inc.'s common stock. Intermarket filed its Schedule 13D on November 13, 2026, after signing a transaction support agreement on November 5. The agreement ties Intermarket to a proposed debt exchange and an $85 million share offering, with a conditional commitment to buy shares for up to $15 million.

Investor Intent

Intermarket agreed to support Pyxus International's debt exchanges and equity offering, and to have certain funds and accounts it manages exchange or tender their existing debt. The agreement also requires those funds and accounts to provide related consents and vote their common shares in favor of changes to the shareholders agreement.

Intermarket committed to purchase shares for a maximum of about $15 million at $2.50 per share, through direct allocations and backstop commitments. That could cover approximately 6 million shares, but the purchase depends on the debt exchanges closing and meeting conditions that include a minimum participation level.

Investor's Background

Intermarket is a New York corporation that provides investment advisory services. David B. Forer and Thomas P. Borger each own 50% of the firm and serve as its co-CEOs. They jointly control Intermarket, which manages investment funds and accounts.

data.title: FAA Grounds All Incoming Flights Nationwide In 'Extraordinary' Advisory, Airline Stocks End Lower
data.description:
Key points:
  • Inbound international flights already in the air will be managed by air traffic controllers on a case-by-case basis.
  • This is the third nationwide FAA ground stop in modern U.S. history, following 9/11 and a January 2023 outage.
  • Airline stocks ended modestly lower, led by United (UAL), down about 1.7%, though the advisory landed shortly before the close.

The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ordered a rare nationwide ground stop Friday afternoon, halting all departing U.S. flights until further notice, citing extraordinary circumstances and safety reasons due to a communication issue at air traffic control centers, sending airline stocks modestly lower.

"Attention all aircraft operators, by order of the Federal Aviation Command Center, all airports are ground stopped," the message read, without giving further information on the cause. “All departing traffic should remain ground stopped until further notice.”

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the nationwide ground stop followed a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers, the facilities that manage flights through large sections of U.S. airspace.

“FAA technicians are investigating the issue, and the agency will provide immediate updates as they become available,” Duffy said in an X post.

Airline Stocks End Lower

The late timing limited the market reaction. United Airlines (UAL) fell about 1.7% to lead the group, American Airlines (AAL) fell about 1%, the U.S. Global Jets ETF (JETS) fell about 0.7%, Southwest (LUV) fell about 0.6%, and Delta (DAL) fell about 0.4%, on a day the broader market was already lower on the PPI print.

The last time the FAA issued a nationwide stop was a morning pause to departures in 2023, which cleared in hours.

Cyber Stocks Gain Post Market

Cybersecurity stocks gained in extended trading on Friday, reversing their regular-session losses after the FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop. CrowdStrike (CRWD) rose about 1.7% to $230.53 after hours, while Palo Alto Networks (PANW) climbed about 1.8% to $327.90, as traders weighed whether the communication failure behind the stop had a cyber angle. Duffy did not explicitly cite a cyber attack as a reason for the grounding of flights.

Retail Sentiment

Retail sentiment on Stocktwits had not yet turned on the news at the close: sentiment on JETS scored 'bullish' in the latest sample, while UAL messages ran mostly ‘neutral’ as traders waited for the reason behind the stop.

For updates and corrections, email newsroom[at]stocktwits[dot]com.

  • CEO Amir F. Heshmatpour purchased 80,000 shares for $269,082, using personal funds; the company issued no shares.
